Demon's Blazon - Makaimura Monshou Hen.name: Demon's Crest
Demon's Blazon - Makaimura Monshou Hen.summary: This is the third game featuring Firebrand from the Gargoyle's Quest series. It is side a scrolling platformer.

Fatal Fury 2.name: Fatal Fury 2
Fatal Fury 2.summary: After Geese Howard's death in the original Fatal Fury, a mysterious nobleman becomes the sponsor of the new "King of Fighters" tournament. This time, the tournament is held worldwide with fighters around the globe competing. As the single player mode progresses, the mysterious challenger begins defeating the participants from the previous Fatal Fury game, searching for the man responsible for defeating Geese.

Lethal Weapon.name: Lethal Weapon
Lethal Weapon.summary: SNES and Nintendo Super System version of Lethal Weapon.

WWF Royal Rumble.name: WWF Royal Rumble
WWF Royal Rumble.summary: Control one of twelve World Wrestling Federation stars in a "no holds barred brawl" -- in other words, do whatever moves you want, from choke holds, piledrivers, and even chair slams, until your opponent is knocked out. You can even go outside the ring if you like. Several modes of play are available, including one-on-one, tag team (two-on-two), and three-on-three tag team. You can play as the following WWF wresters: Bret Hart, Razor Ramon, Randy Savage, Shawn Michaels, The Undertaker, Tatanka, Mr. Perfect, Crush, Ric Flair, Yokozuna, Ted Dibiase, and Lex Luger.
